verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say the review surfaces issues that matter without low-signal feedback, ranks findings by severity with why and how to fix, and reviews the full codebase to catch breaking changes and spec gaps that diff-only tools miss. That covers the 'not just style nits' half of the story. However, nothing documents detection of the specific bug classes named, and there is no hands-on evidence of review accuracy. missing for 10: explicit evidence of catching logic errors, race conditions, and broken edge cases; independent or hands-on corroboration of real-bug detection rates.
